name: Papy Sylphid
original_name: ハッピー・シルフィード
source:
A harpy who possesses the element of wind.

She’s flighty and a bit of a ditz. She’s a bright girl, but not in the smart sense. She has a talent for making accessories and other small objects with her wind element. She’s also in charge of keep the ranch clean and orderly.

One day she was carelessly flying through the sky when she smelled something good cooking at Erogelsus’ home. She floated down towards the smell, where her bright energetic personality led her to quickly make friends with everyone on the ranch, leading her to decide to live with them.
